correctness.rationale: Direct multiplication gives an if-and-only-if collision criterion with no commutativity assumption. Row-pair collision counts yield the Pearson identity. Pairwise row-pair independence and pair-indicator independence give exact mean/variance. A block-diagonal multivariate CLT yields independent Gaussian limiting row-pair blocks despite higher-order dependencies, and a summable second-moment argument proves almost-sure convergence under any coupling. Direct labeled exhaustive checks over C2, C3, and nonabelian S3 reproduce the exact counts and moments.

value.rationale: The idempotent-product density quantifies how close a completely simple semigroup comes to orthodox behavior, a natural multiplication invariant. An exact collision identity yields a rigid baseline, equality characterization, finite moments and universal non-Gaussian fluctuations for all finite nonabelian as well as abelian groups; joint triple-ratio dependence is properly handled and the invariant varies nontrivially with the random multiplication table.
